title: Home Oxygen Therapy Equipment Months Alongside a PAP Therapy Equipment Rental
content:
# Equipment Months Alongside a PAP Device — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy equipment month paid in full by the coverage, the amount is multiplied by:

- **97 percent** when the patient's PAP Therapy Equipment device record names the same coverage as the oxygen record, carries no ownership date, has fewer than 13 PAP rental months paid, and began its payment period at least **3** whole calendar months before the posting date;
- **99 percent** when the PAP device record carries an ownership date, or 13 or more PAP rental months have been paid;
- **100 percent** otherwise.

The PAP rental months paid are the paid rental lines on the PAP device record's claim history. The posting date is the day the equipment month is posted. The multiplication acts on the amount as it stands, without rounding.

## Records read from PAP Therapy Equipment

| Item on the PAP device record | Used for |
|---|---|
| the coverage it names | same coverage as the oxygen record |
| ownership date | present or absent |
| paid rental months | fewer than 13, or 13 or more |
| payment-period start date | at least 3 whole calendar months before the posting date |

## Truth table

| Same coverage | Ownership date | PAP rental months paid | Payment period began at least 3 whole months before posting | Percentage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | none | fewer than 13 | yes | 97 |
| yes | none | fewer than 13 | no | 100 |
| no | none | fewer than 13 | yes | 100 |
| either | present | any | either | 99 |
| either | none | 13 or more | either | 99 |
| no PAP device record | — | — | — | 100 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, posting date 20 August)

- PAP payment period began 20 May, same coverage, no ownership date, 3 months paid: 3 whole months, so 97 percent.
- PAP payment period began 21 May, otherwise the same: 2 whole months, so 100 percent.
- 12 PAP rental months paid, otherwise qualifying for 97 percent: 97 percent; 13 paid: 99 percent.
